open_points.text: - read_service_record: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise RefusedError naming the first failing check of the record itself, in this order: the record is absent at that revision, is not valid JSON — a record nesting deeper than the imported RELEASE_CEILING_JSON_DEPTH_MAX constant, depth as canonical_bytes defines it, measured without recursion before it is parsed, is not valid JSON —, lacks service or capabilities, its service field differs from service_id, two capabilities share a name.
open_points.question: Which passage must change: must canonical_bytes expose the depth definition or a depth result, or must read_service_record define the depth calculation independently instead of requiring depth “as canonical_bytes defines it”?
